statement: SpaceX said it has decided to build exclusively on NVIDIA, citing the Vera Rubin architecture as the best available AI computer.
why: A large AI compute buyer publicly committing to a single vendor is a design win that locks out competing accelerators for that buyer's entire buildout.

impact.mechanism: Vendor exclusivity by a multi-gigawatt buyer converts a share contest into locked demand for NVIDIA and forecloses AMD and in-house silicon at that account.

evidence.excerpt: Going forward, we've decided to build exclusively on Nvidia, because we think the Vera Rubin architecture is the best architecture.

confidence.basis: Secondary transcript of the customer's own earnings call; no NVIDIA release confirms it, per the document's own chase note.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 1 -> 3; sources: Investing.com (SpaceX Q2 2026 earnings call transcript)
